xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5665: Flywheel 'Start fresh' shows the previous run's transcript until the new session is up

plan.title: Flywheel 'Start fresh' shows the previous run's transcript until the new session is up
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Every Flywheel run is named conv-flywheel, and ConversationPanel keys its messages, subagent and about caches by name. The Flywheel pane renders the panel with no key, so after Start fresh the new row (reached through the 5 s poll or the start mutation's invalidation) reuses the old run's cache. The stream's 'discovering' events and the no-shrink snapshot merge keep the old rows until the new harness writes its transcript. The rowid can repeat across runs because the conversations table has no AUTOINCREMENT.
narratives.Proposal: Fix in the Flywheel pane only. A run identity id:createdAt and a per-QueryClient cache owner (WeakMap) in flywheelApi.ts; the pane claims the cache for the row's identity in a useLayoutEffect, clearing the name-keyed caches and composer echoes when the owner changes, and renders ConversationPanel keyed by identity only after the claim. While the start mutation is pending, the pane body shows 'Starting a fresh Flywheel…' or 'Starting the Flywheel…'. Docs and a changelog entry describe the behavior.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Re-keying conversationMessagesQueryKey or any shared conversation cache by id across the app; ConversationPanel.tsx stays unchanged
- The Command Deck /conv/conv-flywheel pane and other conversations recreated under the same name
- Server-side transcript resolution for non-Claude harnesses (PAN-5668)
- Clearing failed-send outbox entries or slash-command results of the old run
- Any change to startFlywheel, vacateConversationName or the conversation routes

autoDecisions.summary: Fix lives in FlywheelConversationPane + flywheelApi.ts, not in ConversationPanel
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue scopes the fix to the pane; re-keying the shared cache touches five consumer files and eight test files for no extra benefit to this bug.

autoDecisions.summary: Run identity is id:createdAt, not id or claudeSessionId
autoDecisions.rationale: conversations.rowid has no AUTOINCREMENT so a deleted row's id can be reused; claudeSessionId can change mid-run on fork adoption or /clear; created_at is written once at insert.

autoDecisions.summary: Clear in a layout effect gated before the panel renders, independent of the start mutation
autoDecisions.rationale: A CLI `pan flywheel start --fresh` and the popout window have no mutation in this tab; gating before the first render keeps the old cache off screen and keeps a stale resume payload out of the new subscription.

autoDecisions.summary: On a known run change, reset run-bound composer state: echoes and /pan command results cleared, held-offline prompts turned into cancelled outbox entries; rejected sends kept
autoDecisions.rationale: Plan critic round 1: command results render in the new run and held prompts auto-send to the reused name; rejected sends need an explicit operator retry anyway.

autoDecisions.summary: Placeholder covers plain Start too, with different text
autoDecisions.rationale: An idle pane can still show an archived row; all three start.run call sites go through one pending flag.

autoDecisions.summary: Non-Claude server-side transcript fallback filed as PAN-5668 instead of fixed here
autoDecisions.rationale: The incident ran on Claude Code, whose read path resolves only the new session file; the name-keyed lookups for codex/pi/acp/kimi are a different subsystem and need their own verification.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. useRunAction (lines 64-76) also returns pendingFresh = mutation.isPending && (mutation.variables as {fresh?: boolean} | undefined)?.fresh === true. In the body, a start.pending branch comes before the conversationQuery.isLoading branch (line 229) and renders <div data-testid="flywheel-starting"> with a spinning Loader2 and 'Starting a fresh Flywheel…' when pendingFresh, else 'Starting the Flywheel…'; it replaces the panel, the terminal and the empty state.
